literal_meaning: লোকের দৃষ্টিকোণ থেকে এবং ধর্মের দৃষ্টিকোণ থেকে
figurative_meaning_en: From the perspective of society and religion
example_sentences_in_bangla: লোকতঃ ধর্মতঃ এই প্রথা অনুসরণ করা উচিত।
example_sentences_in_english: From the perspective of society and religion, this practice should be followed.
His actions are condemnable from the perspective of society and religion.
note: This idiom draws from Sanskrit grammatical forms (tad-anta compounds) commonly used in classical Bengali literature to denote dual perspectives.
